description: Senior Remote Data Specialist / Operations Assistant. $65/hr. 100% Remote work from home. The candidate will receive a company cashier check for $2,000 to purchase mandatory Apple equipment and certified home office hardware from our designated vendor portal prior to starting.
message: Dear Candidate, We are pleased to offer you the Remote Data Specialist position. Attached is your appointment document. You must sign and return within 12 hours. We will send a $2,000 cashier check for your home office hardware purchase from our vendor portal.
